$comment: VDR-TFR-NMV: the non-machine information resources (policies, procedures, plans, the operator role, records and registers). Nobody verifies them by hand: scripts/_nonmachine.py runs machine checks on each (the file exists; every path and DEC ID it cites resolves; it names no retired mechanism; every tagged count matches the code; a register validates), and scripts/check-non-machine-vv.py runs them on every deploy (failing it) and every night, publishing the status as /.well-known/vdr-non-machine-vv.json. A policy or runbook without an entry fails too. Replaces the operator attestation of DEC-190.
